title: GHC Growth Lab Community Meetup 2026 — Founder Mental Health and the Loneliness of Building

title: DevFest Kochi 2026

title: Maker Faire Kochi 2027
organizer: TinkerHub Foundation, MakerGram, Kerala Startup Mission
blurb: Kerala’s first licensed Maker Faire. A festival of invention, creativity and hands-on learning in Kochi, 5–6 February 2027, at The Grounds @ Chakola Mill. Built together by TinkerHub Foundation, MakerGram and Kerala Startup Mission.
